_comment: Zone definitions per camera. PLACEHOLDER GEOMETRY — the polygons below were
traced against Human_detection/b.jpg (a found stock image) purely so the zone
layer has something to run against. They are throwaway. Once a frame from the
real mounted camera exists, retrace every polygon against it and bump
frame_width/frame_height to match. Do not tune anything against these numbers.
frame_width/frame_height are the ORIGINAL-IMAGE pixel dimensions the polygons
were traced against. inference/model.py returns bboxes in original-image space
(ultralytics rescales box.xyxy back from imgsz), so these must match the camera's
capture resolution. If they don't, zones.py raises rather than silently scoring

crowd_thresholds._comment: Headcount bands. green < amber <= x < red <= x. PLACEHOLDER — real mess capacity is unknown and these are calibrated against whatever the detector reports, not ground truth. Re-tune once real footage + a settled model exist.
